text_field.encoding: 12 consecutive 6-bit integers MSB-first, left to right
text_field.raw_text_only: These twelve alphabet characters are a radio frame's encoded inner text field, NOT necessarily human-readable displayed message; JS8Call varicode/dictionary/frame assembly layer is still required.

frame_type_flag_semantics: NOT YET PINNED TO A VERSIONED MESSAGE-PROTOCOL SOURCE

provenance.note: The inner 72-bit character field is established; application-layer rendering cannot be inferred from these 12 bytes alone.

message_codec.note: Source provenance for numeric bit layout; independent real-recording check on WO7I

verification.comparison: Verifies physical codeword, not rendered JS8 heartbeat; K8IMT/K7YXZ hard tones do not pass parity/CRC; KD7WPQ missing

directed_frame.callsign: 28-bit packed base callsign; right-to-left radix 27 for the final three suffix positions (alphabet A-Z and blank), radix 10 for digit, radix 36 for second prefix position, remaining quotient for first prefix position; portable flags in bits 7 and 6 of extra
directed_frame.extra: When numeric directed SNR is present, lower 6 bits encode signed SNR offset by 31; 0 means numeric absent, valid 1..61 maps -30..+30; verify command-specific rules
